entries.Translated:

Boss还会吸取梦魔剩余血量的生命，是否击杀由你决定。

entries.Original:
There is 3 sets of adds that spawn at HP %'s -> (90%, 65%, 40%) 
A resolution can make the adds permanently disappear once they are at 0% HP/the corpse are just laying on the floor.
Resolution is also does high damage to the adds + 0.3% to the Boss
Solo tip: Either pop a resolution on all add packs, or pop lust -> resolution on 2nd ad pack. Make sure to keep regen up!
entries.Translated:
共有3组小怪按血量百分比生成 -> (90%, 65%, 40%)
当小怪血量降至0%/尸体倒地后，使用解答所可使其永久消失。
解答所还会对小怪造成高额伤害 + 对Boss造成0.3%伤害
单刷提示：要么对每组小怪都使用解答所，要么对第2组小怪使用欲望 -> 解答所。务必保持回复效果！

entries.Original: Keep using duty action on the

away from the MEs. Meanwhile destroy the MEs asap because they will blow
up on their own after about 35s. If any ME detonates you will be wiped.
The MEs are weak against water abilities and strong against fire attacks.
entries.Translated:
会在战斗中生成炸弹和魔导爆炸物。
使用鼻息将炸弹从魔导爆炸物旁推开，并将火球
从ME旁引开。同时尽快摧毁ME，因为它们会在约35秒后
自行爆炸。若任何ME引爆，将导致团灭。
ME对水属性能力较弱，对火属性攻击较强。

将施放野兽的直觉，使其所有攻击变为暴击。
使用怪音波驱散它。

immune to damage. Use Eerie Soundwave to dispel it. Caber Toss must be
interrupted or you wipe.

entries.Translated:
将施放换羽，使其几乎
免疫伤害。使用怪音波驱散它。投掷必须
打断，否则团灭。
此外，第2阶段推荐使用蜕皮和土属性法术。

entries.Original:

As soon as he starts casting Web go to the edge to bait Meteor, then use Loom
to escape. You can start the Final Sting combination at about 50% health left.
(Off-guard->Bristle->Moonflute->Final Sting)
entries.Translated:
将在魔法和物理反射之间切换。
注意这一点，以免误杀自己。
一旦他开始施放蛛网，就前往末路尽头引诱陨石，然后使用织网逃脱。你可以在剩余约50%血量时开始终极针连招。
(破防->怒发冲冠->月笛->终极针)

entries.Original:

since they will spam raidwides. The adds are immune against magic
and fire attacks.

因为它们会不断施放全屏攻击。小怪免疫魔法
和火属性攻击。

entries.Original: ! Use physical attacks except fire aspected.

and switch between both in act 3. Loom, Exuviation and Diamondback
are recommended. In act 3 can start the Final Sting combination
at about 50% health left. (Off-guard->Bristle->Moonflute->Final Sting)
entries.Translated:
在第1阶段反射所有物理伤害，第2阶段反射所有魔法伤害，
第3阶段在两者之间切换。推荐使用织网、蜕皮和超硬化。
在第3阶段可以在剩余约50%血量时开始终极针连招。
(破防->怒发冲冠->月笛->终极针)

entries.Translated:

否则它们会爆炸导致团灭。要在不接触

(破防->怒发冲冠->月笛->终极针)

小侦测会对你施加一个减益效果。使用超硬化来存活

entries.Original:
The first act is easy. Kill the grenades in one hit each or they will wipe you.
If you gear is bad consider using 1000 Needles.
For the 2nd act you should bring Sticky Tongue. In the 2nd act you can start
the Final Sting combination at about 50%
health left. (Off-guard->Bristle->Moonflute->Final Sting)
entries.Translated:
第1幕很简单。手雷必须一击击杀，否则会导致团灭。
如果装备较差，可以考虑使用千针刺。
第2幕应携带滑舌。在第2幕中，剩余约50%血量时
可以开始终极针连招。
（破防→怒发冲冠→月笛→终极针）

entries.Original: Kill the grenades in one hit each or they will wipe you. They got 543 HP.
entries.Translated: 手雷必须一击击杀，否则会导致团灭。它们有543点生命值。

entries.Original:
Interrupt The Rams Keeper with Spitting Sardine. You can start the
Final Sting combination at about 50% health left.
(Off-guard->Bristle->Moonflute->Final Sting).
The boss will sometimes spawn an Arena Imp during the fight.
entries.Translated:
使用投掷沙丁鱼打断拉姆守护者。剩余约50%血量时
可以开始终极针连招。
（破防→怒发冲冠→月笛→终极针）。
Boss有时会在战斗中生成斗场小魔精。

entries.Original:
The imps are weak to fire spells and strong against ice.
Interrupt Void Blizzard with Spitting Sardine.
entries.Translated:
小魔精弱火、抗冰。
使用投掷沙丁鱼打断虚空冰结。

entries.Original:
The first act is fairly easy. Interrupt the Void Blizzards with Spitting
Sardine and most of the danger is gone. The Imps are weak against fire spells.
In the 2nd act you can start the Final Sting combination at about 50%
health left. (Off-guard->Bristle->Moonflute->Final Sting)
entries.Translated:
第1幕相当简单。使用投掷沙丁鱼打断虚空冰结，
大部分危险就解除了。小魔精弱火。
第2幕中剩余约50%血量时可以开始终极针连招。
（破防→怒发冲冠→月笛→终极针）

entries.Original:
This act is act 1+2 combined with tentacles on top.
The Final Sting combo (Off-guard->Bristle->Moonflute->Final Sting) makes
this act including the achievement much easier. Ultros is weak to fire.
entries.Translated:
本幕是第1幕+第2幕的组合，外加触手。
终极针连招（破防→怒发冲冠→月笛→终极针）能让
本幕（包括成就）轻松许多。奥尔特罗斯弱火。

entries.Original: Ultros is weak to fire. Interrupt Imp Song.
entries.Translated: 奥尔特罗斯弱火。打断河童之歌。

entries.Original:
Diamondback and Flying Sardine are essential for this stage. The Final
Sting combo (Off-guard->Bristle->Moonflute->Final Sting) can make act 3
including the achievement much easier. Ultros in act 2 and 3 is weak to
fire.
entries.Translated:
超硬化和投掷沙丁鱼是本阶段的关键。终极针连招
（破防→怒发冲冠→月笛→终极针）能让第3幕
（包括成就）轻松许多。第2幕和第3幕的奥尔特罗斯
弱火。

entries.Original: Boss will reflect all magic damage!

Same as first act, but this time the boss will cast a gaze from all directions.
The easiest counter for this is to blind yourself by casting Ink Jet on the
boss after it casted Schizocarps.
The Final Sting combo window opens at around 75% health.
(Off-guard->Bristle->Moonflute->Final Sting)
entries.Translated:
与第1幕相同，但这次Boss会从所有方向施放凝视。
最简单的应对方法是在Boss施放播种后，
对其使用喷墨使自己致盲。
终极针连招窗口在约75%血量时开启。
（破防→怒发冲冠→月笛→终极针）

entries.Original:
At the start of the fight Rebekkah will cast Reflect. This will reflect all
magic damage back to you. Useful skills: Sharpened Knife,
Flying Sardine, Ink Jet (Act 2), Exuviation (Act 2), potentially a Final Sting
combo. (Off-guard->Bristle->Moonflute->Final Sting)
entries.Translated:
战斗开始时蕾贝卡会施放反射。这会将所有
魔法伤害反射回你身上。有用的技能：锋利菜刀、
投掷沙丁鱼、喷墨（第2幕）、蜕皮（第2幕），可能还有终极针
连招。（破防→怒发冲冠→月笛→终极针）

entries.Original:
Same as last stage. Make the manticores run to the kegs and their attacks
will make them blow up. Their attacks will also do friendly fire damage
to each other.
The Ram's Voice and Ultravibration combo can be used to kill manticores.
entries.Translated:
与上一阶段相同。让蝎尾狮跑向酒桶，它们的攻击
会引爆酒桶。它们的攻击也会对彼此造成
友方伤害。
可以使用寒冰咆哮和超振动连招击杀蝎尾狮。

entries.Original:
Make the manticores run to the kegs and their attacks will make them
blow up. They take 2500 damage per keg explosion.
The Ram's Voice and Ultravibration combo can be used to kill manticores.
entries.Translated:
让蝎尾狮跑向酒桶，它们的攻击会引爆
酒桶。每个酒桶爆炸造成2500点伤害。
可以使用寒冰咆哮和超振动连招击杀蝎尾狮。

entries.Original:
is weak to lightning spells.
During the fight he will spawn one of each claws as known from act 1.
If available use the Ram's Voice + Ultravibration combo for instant kill.
entries.Translated:
弱雷系法术。
战斗中他会生成第1幕中已知的每种爪子各一个。
如果可用，使用寒冰咆哮+超振动连招可瞬间击杀。

entries.Original:
counters physical
attacks. If you have healing spells you can just tank the counter damage
and kill them however you like anyway. All opponents in this stage are
weak to lightning.
The Ram's Voice and Ultravibration combo can be used in Act 2.
entries.Translated:
反制物理
攻击。如果你有治疗法术，可以直接硬抗反制伤害，
随意击杀它们。本阶段所有敌人
都弱雷。
第2幕可以使用寒冰咆哮和超振动连招。

entries.Original:
Tikbalang will spawn a cyclops a few seconds into the fight. Make sure
to kill it before it reaches you. After that you can just slowly take down the
boss. Use Diamondback to survive the 1111 Tonze Swing. Alternatively
you can try the Final Sting combo when he drops to about 75% health.
(Off-guard->Bristle->Moonflute->Final Sting)
entries.Translated:
迪克巴朗会在战斗开始几秒后生成一个独眼巨人。确保
在它接近你之前将其击杀。之后你可以慢慢击败
Boss。使用超硬化来存活1111吨重挥击。或者
当他血量降至约75%时，你可以尝试终极针连招。
（破防→怒发冲冠→月笛→终极针）

entries.Original:
The cyclops are very slow, but will instantly kill you, if they catch you.
Kite them or kill them with the self-destruct combo. (Toad Oil->Bristle->
Moonflute->Swiftcast->Self-destruct) If you don't use the self-destruct
combo in act 1, you can bring the Final Sting combo for act 2.
(Off-guard->Bristle->Moonflute->Final Sting)
Diamondback is highly recommended in act 2.
entries.Translated:
独眼巨人非常缓慢，但如果被它们抓住会立即将你击杀。
风筝它们，或用自爆连招击杀它们。（油性分泌物→怒发冲冠→
月笛→即刻咏唱→自爆）如果你在第1幕不使用自爆
连招，可以为第2幕携带终极针连招。
（破防→怒发冲冠→月笛→终极针）
第2幕强烈建议使用超硬化。

entries.Original:
For this stage Flying Sardine and Acorn Bomb are highly recommended.
Use Flying Sardine to interrupt High Voltage.
Use Acorn Bomb to put Shabtis to sleep until their buff runs out.
entries.Translated:
本阶段强烈建议使用投掷沙丁鱼和橡果炸弹。
使用投掷沙丁鱼打断高压。
使用橡果炸弹让沙布提入睡，直到其增益消失。

entries.Original: Use the cube to take cover!

Same as first act, but the slimes will apply heavy to you.
Use Loom to get out of line of sight as soon as Final Song gets casted.
entries.Translated:
与第1幕相同，但史莱姆会对你施加重伤。
一旦终曲开始施放，立即使用织网脱离视线。

entries.Original:
These slimes start casting Final Song after death.
While Final Song is not deadly, it does heavy damage and applies silence
to you. Take cover! For act 2 the spell Loom is strongly recommended.
The slimes are strong against blunt melee damage such as J Kick.
entries.Translated:
这些史莱姆死亡后开始施放终曲。
虽然终曲不致命，但会造成大量伤害并施加沉默
效果。快躲避！第2幕强烈建议使用织网法术。
史莱姆抗钝击近战伤害，例如J踢。

entries.Original:
Camilla will cast various AOEs and summons adds.
Interrupt the adds with Flying Sardine and kill them fast.
If the add is still alive during the next Black Sabbath, you will be wiped.
entries.Translated:
卡米拉会施放各种AOE并召唤小怪。
使用投掷沙丁鱼打断小怪并快速击杀它们。
如果小怪在下一次黑色安息日时仍然存活，将会团灭。

entries.Original:
The first act is trivial, almost anything will work.
For act 2 having Flying Sardine is recommended.
entries.Translated:
第1幕很简单，几乎任何技能都行。
第2幕建议携带投掷沙丁鱼。

entries.Original:
Use Bomb Toss to stun Hydnora when he casts Inflammable Fumes.
Use Ice Spikes to instantly kill roselets once they become aggressive.
Hydnora is weak against water and strong against earth spells.
entries.Translated:
当海德诺拉施放易燃气体时，使用炸弹投掷将其眩晕。
一旦玫瑰怪变得具有攻击性，使用冰棘将其瞬间击杀。
海德诺拉弱水、抗土系法术。

entries.Original:
For this stage Ice Spikes and Bomb Toss are recommended spells.
Use Ice Spikes to instantly kill roselets once they become aggressive.
Hydnora in act 2 is weak against water and strong against earth spells.
entries.Translated:
本阶段建议使用冰棘和炸弹投掷法术。
一旦玫瑰怪变得具有攻击性，使用冰棘将其瞬间击杀。
第2幕的海德诺拉弱水、抗土系法术。

entries.Original:
Same as last act, but this time there are 4 bombs. Pull them to the
middle with Sticky Tongue and attack them with any AOE to keep them
interrupted. They are weak against wind and strong against fire.
entries.Translated:
与上一幕相同，但这次有4个炸弹。使用滑舌将它们拉到
中间，并用任意AOE攻击它们以保持
打断。它们弱风、抗火。

entries.Original:
These bombs start self-destruction on combat start. Pull them together
with Sticky Tongue and attack them with anything to interrupt them.
They are weak against wind and strong against fire.
entries.Translated:
这些炸弹在战斗开始时就会开始自爆。使用滑舌
将它们拉到一起，并用任意技能攻击以打断它们。
它们弱风、抗火。

entries.Original:
Crom Dubh will cast King's Will during the fight. Interrupt it with
Flying Sardine or he will become stronger each time. After 3 casts he
starts using the interruptible enrage Black Nebula.
entries.Translated:
幽黑曲偶会在战斗中施放圣意。用
投掷沙丁鱼打断它，否则它每次都会变得更强。施放3次后它
会开始使用可打断的狂暴技能暗黑星云。

entries.Original:
Guimauve summons a total of 6 adds during the fight, one of each element.
Healer mimikry can be helpful if you have trouble surviving.
entries.Translated:
棉花软糖在战斗中总共会召唤6个元素各一的增援。
如果你难以存活，治疗拟态会很有帮助。

entries.Original:
Clever activation of cherry bombs will freeze the Progenitrix.
Interrupt its burst skill or wipe. The Progenitrix is weak to wind spells.
entries.Translated:
巧妙地引爆爆弹仔可以冻结爆弹之母。
打断它的爆发技能，否则团灭。爆弹之母弱风属性法术。

entries.Original:
For this stage the spell Flying Sardine to interrupt the Progenitrix in Act 2
is highly recommended. Hit the Cherry Bomb from a safe distance
with anything but fire damage to set of a chain reaction to win this act.
entries.Translated:
本阶段强烈推荐使用投掷沙丁鱼法术来打断第二幕中的爆弹之母。
从安全距离用除火属性以外的任何伤害击中爆弹仔
以引发连锁反应，赢得本幕。

entries.Original: Hit the Cherry Bomb from a safe distance to win this act.
entries.Translated: 从安全距离击中爆弹仔以赢得本幕。

entries.Original:
Pull or push the Lava Slimes to the towers and then hit the slimes
from a distance to set off the explosions. The towers create a damage
pulse every 12s and a deadly explosion when they die. Take cover.
entries.Translated:
将熔岩粘液怪拉或推到塔上，然后从远处击中粘液怪
以引发大引爆。塔每12秒产生一次伤害脉冲，
死亡时会产生致命大引爆。注意躲避。

entries.Original:
Pull or push the Lava Slimes to the Ice Sprites and then hit the slimes
from a distance to set of the explosions.
entries.Translated:
将熔岩粘液怪拉或推到冰元精处，然后从远处击中粘液怪
以引发大引爆。

entries.Original:
For this stage the spells Sticky Tongue and Snort are recommended.
Use them to pull or push Slimes close toIce Sprites.
Then hit the slime from a distance with anything but fire spells to set of an explosion.
entries.Translated:
本阶段推荐使用滑舌和鼻息法术。
用它们将粘液怪拉或推到冰元精附近。
然后用除火属性法术以外的任何伤害从远处击中粘液怪以引发大引爆。

entries.Original: Hit the Lava Slime from a safe distance to win this act.
entries.Translated: 从安全距离击中熔岩粘液怪以赢得本幕。

entries.Original: The eyes are weak to lightning spells.

Get blinded by the Teary Twirl AOE from the mandragoras.
Blindness makes you immune to all the gaze attacks.
The eyes in act 2 are weak to lightning damage.
entries.Translated:
被曼德拉草的洋葱汁AOE致盲。
致盲会使你免疫所有凝视攻击。
第二幕中的眼镜岩弱雷属性伤害。

entries.Original:
These turtles have very high defenses.
Bring 1000 Needles or Doom to defeat them.
Alternatively you can remove their buff with Eerie Soundwave.
entries.Translated:
这些乌龟防御力极高。
带上千针刺或厄运来击败它们。
或者你可以用怪音波移除它们的增益。

entries.Original:
Kreios is weak to lightning spells.
During the fight he will spawn 6 beetles.
If available use the Ram's Voice + Ultravibration combo for the instant kill.
entries.Translated:
克瑞俄斯弱雷属性法术。
战斗中他会召唤6只甲虫。
如果有条件，使用寒冰咆哮+超振动连招来秒杀。

entries.Original: Kreios is weak against lightning spells and can be frozen.
entries.Translated: 克瑞俄斯弱雷属性法术，且可以被冻结。

entries.Original:
Trivial act. Enemies here are weak to lightning and fire.
In Act 2 the Ram's Voice and Ultravibration combo can be useful.
Flying Sardine for interrupts can be beneficial.
entries.Translated:
简单的一幕。这里的敌人弱雷和火属性。
第二幕中寒冰咆哮和超振动连招会很有用。
投掷沙丁鱼用于打断会很有益。

entries.Original:
Bats are weak to lightning.
The wolf is weak to fire.
entries.Translated:
蝙蝠弱雷属性。
狼弱火属性。

entries.Original:
Zipacna is weak against water based spells.
Flying Sardine is recommended to interrupt raidwide.
entries.Translated:
希帕克纳弱水属性法术。
推荐用投掷沙丁鱼打断全屏攻击。

entries.Original:
Zipacna is weak against water based spells.
Earth based spells are useless against Zipacna.
entries.Translated:
希帕克纳弱水属性法术。
土属性法术对希帕克纳无效。

entries.Original:
Gelato is weak to fire spells.
Flan is weak to lightning spells.
Licorice is weak to water spells.
entries.Translated:
意式冰淇淋弱火属性法术。
布丁弱雷属性法术。
甘草弱水属性法术。

entries.Original:
To beat this stage in a timely manner,
you should have at least one spell of each element.
(Water, Fire, Ice, Lightning, Earth and Wind)
entries.Translated:
为了及时通关本阶段，
你至少应拥有每种元素的一个法术。
（水、火、冰、雷、土和风）

entries.Original:
Pudding is weak to wind spells.
Marshmallow is weak to ice spells.
Bavarois is weak to earth spells.
entries.Translated:
软糊怪弱风属性法术。
棉花糖弱冰属性法术。
巴伐利亚奶冻弱土属性法术。

entries.Original:
This stage is trivial.
Use whatever skills you have to defeat these opponents.
entries.Translated:
本阶段很简单。
用你拥有的任何技能击败这些对手。

entries.Original: Set closest trap location as ignored
entries.Translated: 将最近的陷阱位置设为忽略

entries.Original: Highlighted pomanders will be used when a gold chest contains one that you can't carry.
entries.Translated: 当金宝箱中含有你无法携带的香炉时，将使用高亮的香炉。

entries.Original: The next three interments will be mirrored!
entries.Translated: 接下来三次咏唱将被镜像！

entries.Translated: 接下来四次咏唱将被镜像！
选择下一个 AOE 类型

will tether to the clones on the edge of the arena. Those are the dragons that will be casting a cone.
After a certain point, the boss will tether x2 sets of adds, find the first safe spot, rotate into the next.
entries.Translated:
将与场地边缘的分身连线。那些是会释放扇形攻击的龙。
到达某个时间点后，Boss 会连线两组小怪，找到第一个安全点，然后旋转到下一个。

entries.Translated: 分配无效：职能必须唯一

entries.Translated: Banana Codex：以西为基准；分摊与点名配对

entries.Translated: 诱导 先近（第一或第二）

entries.Translated: 将Boss置于中央或略偏南，然后面向北

entries.Translated: 将Boss置于北侧，然后面向中央
北/西北，若<3心则保持输出

entries.Original: Keep away from the charge attack!
Unable to predict order. Hope your party members were watching!
entries.Translated: 无法预测顺序。希望你的队友有在看！
判决确定：名誉罪 颜色：

entries.Original: Melee greed: find closest safespot, then move to maxmelee closest to it
entries.Translated: 近战贪刀：寻找最近的安全点，然后移动到离它最近的最大近战距离处

entries.Original: Move to the point in maxmelee that is closest to specific point
entries.Translated: 移动到最大近战距离内离指定点最近的位置

entries.Original: Pre-pull position: as close to the clock-spot as possible
entries.Translated: 开怪前站位：尽可能靠近时钟点

entries.Original: Drag boss to the arena center

attributes.Original: Action Tweaks
attributes.Translated: 动作调整

attributes.Original: Remove extra lag-induced animation lock delay from instant casts (read tooltip!)
attributes.Translated: 移除瞬发技能因延迟产生的额外动画锁定延迟（请阅读提示！）

attributes.Original: Do NOT use with XivAlexander or NoClippy - this should automatically disable itself if they are detected, but double check first!
attributes.Translated: 请勿与 XivAlexander 或 NoClippy 同时使用——检测到它们时应会自动禁用，但请先双将确认！

attributes.Original: Animation lock max. simulated delay (read tooltip!)
attributes.Translated: 动画锁定最大模拟延迟（请阅读提示！）

attributes.Original: Configures the maximum simulated delay in milliseconds when using animation lock removal - this is required and cannot be reduced to zero. Setting this to 20ms will enable triple-weaving when using autorotation. The minimum setting to remove triple-weaving is 26ms. The minimum of 20ms has been accepted by FFLogs and should not cause issues with your logs.
attributes.Translated: 配置使用动画锁定移除时的最大模拟延迟（毫秒）——此项为必需项，不能设为零。设为 20ms 可在使用自动循环时实现三插。移除三插的最低设置为 26ms。最低值 20ms 已被 FFLogs 接受，不应影响你的战斗记录。

attributes.Original: Remove extra framerate-induced cooldown delay
attributes.Translated: 移除帧率导致的额外冷却延迟

attributes.Original: Dynamically adjusts cooldown and animation locks to ensure queued actions resolve immediately regardless of framerate limitations
attributes.Translated: 动态调整冷却和动画锁定，确保排队的动作无论帧率限制如何都能立即执行

attributes.Original: Prevent movement while casting
attributes.Translated: 施法时阻止移动

attributes.Original: Hold to allow movement while casting
attributes.Translated: 按住以允许施法时移动

attributes.Original: Automatically cancel a cast when target is dead
attributes.Translated: 目标死亡时自动取消施法

attributes.Original: Prevent movement and action execution when pyretic-like mechanics are imminent (set to 0 to disable, otherwise increase threshold depending on your ping).
attributes.Translated: 在类似灼热机制即将到来时阻止移动和执行动作（设为 0 禁用，否则根据你的延迟增加阈值）。

attributes.Original: Auto misdirection: prevent movement under misdirection if angle between normal movement and misdirected is greater than this threshold (set to 180 to disable).
attributes.Translated: 自动误导：若正常移动方向与误导方向的夹角大于此阈值，则阻止误导下的移动（设为 180 禁用）。

attributes.Original: Use actions on mouseover target
attributes.Translated: 对鼠标悬停目标使用动作

attributes.Original: Use custom queueing for manually pressed actions
attributes.Translated: 对手动按下的动作使用自定义排队

attributes.Original: This setting allows better integration with autorotations and will prevent you from triple-weaving or drifting GCDs if you press a healing ability while autorotation is going on
attributes.Translated: 此设置可更好地与自动循环集成，并防止你在自动循环进行时按下治疗技能导致三插或GCD漂移

attributes.Original: Smart ability targeting
attributes.Translated: 智能技能选定目标

attributes.Original: If the usual (mouseover/primary) target is not valid for an action, select the next best target automatically (e.g. co-tank for Shirk)
attributes.Translated: 若通常（鼠标悬停/攻击目标）目标对某动作无效，则自动选择次优目标（例如对退避选择另一名坦克）

attributes.Original: Try to prevent dashing into AOEs
attributes.Translated: 尝试防止突进进入AOE

attributes.Original:
Prevent automatic use of targeted dashes (like WAR Onslaught) if they would move you into a dangerous area. May not work as expected in instances that do not have modules.

This option will also apply to manually pressed dashes if you have "Use custom queueing for manually pressed actions" enabled.
attributes.Translated:
若定向突进（如战士猛攻）会使你进入危险区域，则阻止其自动使用。在没有模块的副本中可能无法按预期工作。

若你启用了“对手动按下的动作使用自定义排队”，此选项也会应用于手动按下的突进。

attributes.Original: Apply to all dashes, not just gap closers
attributes.Translated: 应用于所有突进，而不仅是接近技能

attributes.Original: Includes backdashes (e.g. SAM Yaten), teleports (e.g. NIN Shukuchi), and fixed-length dashes (e.g. DRG Elusive Jump)
attributes.Translated: 包括后撤（如武士夜天）、传送（如忍者缩地）和固定距离突进（如龙骑回避跳跃）

attributes.Original: Automatically manage auto attacks
attributes.Translated: 自动管理自动攻击

attributes.Original: This setting prevents starting autos early during countdown, starts them automatically at pull, when switching targets and when using any actions that don't explicitly cancel autos.
attributes.Translated: 此设置可防止在倒计时期间提前开始自动攻击，并在开怪、切换目标以及使用任何未明确取消自动攻击的动作时自动开始。

attributes.Original: Automatically dismount to execute actions
attributes.Translated: 自动降落后执行动作

attributes.Original: Automatic target selection for ground-targeted abilities
attributes.Translated: 地面目标技能的自动选定目标

attributes.Original: Cast at selected target's position

attributes.Translated: 引导火焰喷射器时暂停自动循环

attributes.Original: Align Smudge with camera direction
attributes.Translated: 使涂抹与镜头方向对齐

attributes.Original: Prevent use of 'Holy Spirit' too early when in pre-pull
attributes.Translated: 开怪前防止过早使用“圣灵”

attributes.Original: Prevent use of 'Shield Lob' too early when in pre-pull (if Holy Spirit is not unlocked)
attributes.Translated: 开怪前防止过早使用“投盾”（若未解锁圣灵）

attributes.Original: Passage of Arms direction

attributes.Translated: 开怪前防止过早使用虚无收割

attributes.Original: Align Hell's Egress/Ingress with camera direction
attributes.Translated: 使地狱出境/入境与镜头方向对齐

attributes.Original: Prevent use of 'Broil' too early when in pre-pull
attributes.Translated: 开怪前防止过早使用“魔炎法”

attributes.Original: Prefer self-targeted holmgang; requires smart targeting to be enabled (and allows overriding target by mouseover)
attributes.Translated: 优先对自身使用死斗；需要启用智能选定目标（并允许通过鼠标悬停覆盖目标）

attributes.Original: Forbid tomahawk too early in prepull
attributes.Translated: 开怪前防止过早使用飞斧

attributes.Original: Align Aetherial Shift with camera direction
attributes.Translated: 使以太变移与镜头方向对齐

attributes.Original: Smart character orientation
attributes.Translated: 智能角色朝向

attributes.Original:
Replace in-game 'auto face target' option with a smarter alternative.
When using an action, changes direction only if target is not in frontal cone.
During cast, keep character facing the target.
attributes.Translated:
用更智能的方案替换游戏内的“自动面向目标”选项。
使用动作时，仅当目标不在正面锥形范围内才改变方向。
咏唱期间，保持角色面向目标。

attributes.Translated: 通用求解器设置
